customer_message.subject: chat – rent going up after new kitchens
customer_message.body:
Rafael Ortega: hi, I'm at Ahornweg 39 in Dübendorf, 2.5 rooms, Verwaltung Emme & Söhne
Rafael Ortega: they put new kitchens and bathrooms into all flats this year and now the manager says everyone will pay more for that, he mentioned CHF 180 a month
Rafael Ortega: he said the papers will be sent out with the official form "before the end of the year", so I'm waiting for that
Rafael Ortega: 180 seems a lot for a kitchen I didn't ask for. can they do that? what should I watch out for?
